methodology.power_rankings: 45% record, 35% season scoring strength, 20% latest-three scoring form. Weights will become phase-aware once the new season begins.
methodology.editorial: Rankings, legality and evidence are computed before any AI copy pass. Reporters may change assignments by story, but their serious or playful persona never changes.
methodology.transactions: ESPN keeper flags are treated as confirmed. Trade details require ESPN roster/activity evidence or a commissioner-confirmed event; model trade ideas are always labeled rumored.
